collection.title: Cadillac SRX 2009 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit an Cadillax SRX 2009 - 2016 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
